description: Plain autoregressive OCR serving from Tencent’s single-GPU inference/vLLM/serve.sh, with the current 47644ecc target checkpoint and digest-pinned vLLM v0.32.0 ARM64 CUDA 13 image. No speculative decoder or draft weights. Context is bounded to 32768 tokens and concurrency to four. Physical Spark acceptance is pending. Per-node peak is an estimate: 0.35 times 130,663,231,488 bytes plus 8 GB runtime/host overhead. Tencent license terms, including territorial notices, remain informational in the Model. Eager execution avoids the CUDA graph-capture startup failure observed on GB10; graph replay performance is not claimed.
title: HunyuanOCR 1.5 vLLM single Spark
